set.body:
Objective
Execute the complete M0 comparative protocol and publish evidence for accuracy, pattern/support recovery, axis/subspace stability, local access and cost separately.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PERF-01, PERF-02, PAT-01, PAT-02, PAT-05, PAT-06, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
independent performance qualification; frozen benchmark/scenario harness; searchlight/linear/low-rank reference adapters. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M3.15, M4.10, M0.06. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Known-truth suppressor, redundancy, diffuse, fine-sign, wrong-graph, rank/covariance misspecification and ROI-only-dimension cases remain separate visible results.
2. Match splits, training/preparation scope, output metrics, tuning budget, hardware and cold/warm boundaries; disclose unavailable or unmatched baseline costs.
3. Include covariance fitting, selection and retained-output allocation; test the large-shape flagship and local/confirmation workloads against frozen budgets.
4. Do not claim universal searchlight superiority: a separately fit local model and shared-subspace regional query answer different questions.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
sbt mvpaSpatialJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaSpatialJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M5.05: Run matched predictive, localization, stability, and end-to-end performance benchmarks
